DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 描いた紙が向こうへ飛びました。自転車が通っていて、追いかけられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飛散した紙と通行上の障害を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sheet I drew on blew over there. Bicycles are passing, so I cannot chase after it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your sheet blew away and that passing traffic prevents you from retrieving it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路に急に出ないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not step suddenly into the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。木の手前に落ちている一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙の位置を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: All right. It is the one sheet lying just before the tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify where the sheet is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 風がまた吹くかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The wind might pick up again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残りの紙は先にかばんへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残りの飛散を防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put the remaining sheets in my bag first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prevent the remaining sheets from blowing away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 落ちた一枚は、通行が落ち着いてから確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check on the fallen sheet once the traffic settles down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無理に止めに行かず、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収のため急に動かず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here instead of trying to rush out and stop it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait without making a sudden move to retrieve it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾えたときはご自分の絵か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you manage to pick it up, please check that it is your own drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 裏に名前があります。別の紙なら持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収物の識別方法を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My name is on the back. If it is someone else's sheet, I will not take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will identify the recovered sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、通行を見ながら安全に回収できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will watch the traffic and check whether we can retrieve it safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この掲示をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここに十時とあるので、十時に出ると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 到着時刻の誤読を明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says ten o'clock here, so I thought it left at ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you misread the arrival time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄は到着時刻です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発の欄はどこですか。乗る方向も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発欄と方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Where is the departure column? I would also like to check the direction I will be traveling in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where the departure column is and which direction it refers to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見出しと方向を合わせて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check this heading together with the direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 方向は合っています。では、出発はこちらの時刻ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 方向と欄を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The direction is right. So this is the departure time, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the direction against the column. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。日付や運行の案内もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also check the date and service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の案内を見て、友人に送った時刻を訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の案内に基づき訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check today's information and correct the time I sent my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the time based on today's information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人にも欄の違いを伝えるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be good to explain the difference between the columns to your friend too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻だけでなく、出発欄を見たと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ確認根拠も共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them not just the time, but also that I checked the departure column.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the basis for your check with your traveling companion too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その見方でご確認ください。分からなければお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use that approach to check. Ask us if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この資料を掲示する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to post this document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、班員の個人の電話番号が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 掲示資料の個人番号を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But it contains the team members' personal telephone numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the personal telephone numbers in the document to be posted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内部の連絡用資料でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it a document for internal communication?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。公開してよいか本人には聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公開同意が未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have not asked the people concerned whether their numbers may be made public.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that consent for public disclosure has not been confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示用には内容を分ける必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You will need to prepare separate content for public posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を外して、問い合わせ先は活動の窓口にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公開用の問い合わせ先を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to remove the numbers and use the activity's contact office for inquiries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest a contact for inquiries on the public version. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 窓口として載せる先も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also confirm the contact details you intend to list as the contact office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当者の了承を得てから、新しい版を作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 掲載先の了承後に新版を作る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will make a new version after obtaining the person in charge's approval.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make the new version after receiving approval from the contact to be listed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の資料は掲示場所に置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not leave the original document at the posting location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち帰って分けます。公開用だけ後日相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内部版を持ち帰り公開版だけ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home and separate the versions. I will consult you later about the public version only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the internal version home and consult about the public version only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、了承と掲載範囲を確認してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please bring it after confirming the approval and the scope of what may be posted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 右の手首のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your right wrist, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。電話で左右を逆に言いました。痛いのは左です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話時の左右の誤りを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I mixed up left and right on the phone. It is my left wrist that hurts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the left-right mistake you made on the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。右には同じ痛みはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左右の症状を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not have the same pain on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the symptoms on the left and right sides. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録に訂正を付けます。いつ気付きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will add a correction to the record. When did you notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を聞いて、今気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤りに気付いた時点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only just noticed while listening to your instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain when you noticed the mistake. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察でも実際の場所を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please point to the actual location during the examination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左の手首を示して、電話の訂正も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察で実際の部位を示すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will point to my left wrist and explain the correction to what I said on the phone as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to show the actual affected area during the examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の案内も左に直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have also corrected the reception instructions to say left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ほかの症状メモにも左右を書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状メモにも左右を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will add left and right to my notes about the other symptoms too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add left-right information to your symptom notes too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、訂正した記録で担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will pass on the corrected record to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした鍵の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please describe the keys you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二本の鍵に青い札が付いています。札には住所も書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵と住所札の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two keys with a blue tag attached. My address is also written on the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the keys and the address tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その住所はご自宅ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。外で大きな声では言いたくないので、紙で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所を紙で示す配慮を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I would rather not say it loudly outside. Could I show it to you on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to protect your privacy by showing the address on paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらへ記入してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。最後に使ったのは昨夜、自宅に入ったときです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の使用を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written it. I last used the keys when I entered my home last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify when you last used them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その後に立ち寄った場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you stopped anywhere since then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝の店があります。鍵を出したかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立寄り先と不明な行動を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I went to a shop this morning. I do not remember whether I took the keys out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the place you visited from the action you are unsure about. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かることと不明なことを分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record what you know separately from what is uncertain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。見つかるのを待つだけでなく、使用先の管理者にも紛失を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用先への管理相談を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. Besides waiting for them to be found, I will also discuss the loss with the manager of the place where the keys are used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult the management of the place where the keys are used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届け出の内容を確認します。管理の相談は別途お進めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the details of your report. Please arrange the management consultation separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会社名とお名前は書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have written the company name and the recipient's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、部署名を聞き忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部署名が未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I forgot to ask for the department name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the department name has not been confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手の方に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check with the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今連絡できます。同じ姓の方がいるので、確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同姓による識別の必要を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can contact them now. There is someone with the same surname, so I will confirm before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why people with the same surname need to be distinguished. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだお預かりせずにお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will wait without accepting it for mailing yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。営業部と名前を続けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返答に基づき部署を追記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The reply has arrived. I will write the Sales Department followed by the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the department based on the reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所にも変更はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has the address changed at all?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手に確かめました。この住所のままで合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所も相手へ照合したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked with the recipient. This address is still correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you also checked the address with the recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した宛名を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the address and recipient details you have rewritten.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部署と氏名がそろいました。今度はこの一通をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補完した宛名で発送を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The department and full name are both there now. Please send this letter now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to have it sent with the completed recipient details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、補った宛名でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will accept it with the recipient details you have added.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物が通路へ出ていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your belongings are sticking out into the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。まだ操作は始めていません。先に片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未操作のまま荷物を片付けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I have not started using the machine yet. I will put them away first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will tidy your belongings before operating the machine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は全部ご自身の物ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。三つとも私のものです。一つは破れかけています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の所有と破れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. All three are mine. One is starting to tear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain who owns the bags and that one is tearing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こぼれないようにまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please gather them together so the contents do not spill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丈夫な袋へ移します。作業中はATMの前から離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ATM前を離れ丈夫な袋へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will transfer the contents to a sturdy bag. I will move away from the front of the ATM while I do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move away from the ATM and transfer the contents to a sturdy bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの端なら通行を妨げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You will not block people passing if you use this area at the edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこでまとめました。荷物は足元の内側に置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を妨げない収納を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have gathered them together there. I can keep the bags close in beside my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you have stowed the belongings without obstructing traffic. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードや財布も取り違えないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also take care not to mix up your card or wallet with someone else's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布は手元にあります。荷物を整えたので、空いてから操作します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 財布を確認し順番を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: My wallet is with me. Now that my belongings are in order, I will use the machine once it is free.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your wallet and wait your turn. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、通路を空けたままご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please use the machine while keeping the walkway clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the product you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族のメモには「粉」とだけあって、どの粉か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略称だけでは特定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family's note only says “powder,” so I do not know which kind it means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the abbreviated description is not enough to identify it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: What are they planning to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンを作ると言っていました。私が片栗粉だと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途と自己誤認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said they were going to make bread. I had assumed it meant potato starch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain its intended use and your own mistaken assumption. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: パン用の材料は、この売場で種類を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the different kinds of bread-making ingredients in this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に商品名を聞いてから選びます。今の袋は戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族への確認後に選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my family for the product name before choosing. I will put this bag back for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to choose after checking with your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 強力粉でした。袋の種類名もその表示になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返答と商品表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was bread flour. The type printed on the bag says that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the reply against the product label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な量は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you know how much you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一キロと返事が来たので、この一袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定量で購入を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: They replied that we need one kilogram, so I will take this one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on the purchase based on the specified quantity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 種類と量が確認できましたね。こちらをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have confirmed both the type and quantity. Please take this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合は大きな木の下でいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we meet under the big tree?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じくらいの木が二本あります。子供が迷わないよう、別の目印も付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 曖昧な目印の問題を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two trees about the same size. I would like to add another landmark so the children do not get confused.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the problem with an ambiguous landmark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時計の近くの木ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean the tree near the clock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。時計と木を描いて、待つ場所に丸を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 第二の目印を図へ加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will draw the clock and the tree, and circle the place where we should wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add a second landmark to the drawing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 散歩に出た人にも渡しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will you give it to the people who went for a walk too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚を見せて、みんなに同じ場所を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全員に同じ場所を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show everyone one copy and have them all confirm the same location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make sure everyone knows the same meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided on a time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時です。地図にも書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合時刻を図に記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two o'clock. I will write it on the map too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the meeting time on the drawing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わる前に、人数も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before we finish, let us check the number of people too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 参加者の一覧は私が持って、集合したら一人ずつ確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 集合後の人数確認を担当する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the participant list and check everyone individually once we have gathered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take responsibility for checking the headcount after everyone gathers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、場所と時刻をそろえてから写生を始めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start sketching once everyone has the same place and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物ですね。お手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is a large piece of luggage. Do you need help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車を袋に入れています。階段では袋の端を持っていいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋入り自転車の持ち方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a bicycle in this bag. Is it all right to hold the edge of the bag on the stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to carry a bicycle packed in a bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋だけで持ち上げると中身がずれることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you lift it by the bag alone, the contents may shift.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手を確かめて、無理なら階段は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手確認と階段回避を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will check the handles, and if I cannot manage it safely, I will not use the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to check the handles and avoid the stairs if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 段差のない経路をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can show you a route without steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そちらをお願いします。袋を引きずらずに運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段差のない経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to carry it without dragging the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a route without steps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中の部品は固定されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 固定しましたが、持ち上げる前にもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 固定の再確認を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I secured them, but I will check again before lifting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to check again that the parts are secured. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路の端で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check at the edge of the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。持ち手で運んで、案内された経路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の運搬方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will carry it by the handles and use the route you showed me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose how to carry it after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その経路を図でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you that route on a map.
